evaluation_metrics.note: Performance on an educational/synthetic Kaggle symptom-checklist dataset (41 diseases, 304 unique symptom-sets after deduplication) -- NOT clinical accuracy on real patients. Logistic Regression scored equal or higher than XGBoost on this small dataset (reported honestly, not hidden); XGBoost is still exported as production per explicit migration instructions.

known_limitations: Synthetic/educational dataset, not real clinical patient data.
Only 5-10 unique examples per disease class even after deduplication.
94% of the raw dataset was exact-duplicate rows, removed before training.
No age/gender features available in the source dataset.
